evals.prompt: Show me a complete example of building a content pipeline that discovers articles from tech blogs, extracts their content, classifies them by topic, and imports them into a CMS. Describe the stages with the tools and their parameters; do not run anything.
evals.expected_output: Should reference the content-pipeline scenario from examples/references/scenarios/. Should show the full multi-service pipeline: discover sources (Exa) → map URLs (Firecrawl) → batch read (Jina) → extract structured data (Firecrawl) → classify (model or schema enum) → deduplicate (Jina) → import to CMS.
expectations: Discovers the sources with a search tool such as web_search_exa
Maps each source site with firecrawl_map before reading pages
Reads the articles in batches with read_url and says it takes up to 5 URLs per call
Extracts structured data with firecrawl_scrape using the json format with jsonOptions that hold a prompt and a schema
Covers classifying the articles (model or a schema enum) and importing them into the CMS
